episodes.title: Former FBI agent breaks down the Jeffrey Epstein tip nobody investigated | Unreported
episodes.description:
Some stories make headlines. Others get ignored. On "Unreported," Meagan Medick takes a deeper look at the unexplained through the eyes and experiences of you, the viewers. You send the mystery — we investigate. This week, Meagan digs into a former Playboy Playmate's allegations that Hugh Hefner reported Jeffrey Epstein to the FBI after learning she was being assaulted and trafficked — and wonders why nothing happened. Joining Medick is Tracy Walder, a former FBI special agent and CIA officer. 

They discuss how Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell may have sourced and sold information on women to traffic them, why an FBI tip like Hefner's should count as evidence of a crime rather than something agents can simply ignore, whether Epstein could have been protected as a valuable intelligence asset and why the lingering government secrecy around the Epstein files continues to erode public trust. "It's not like this far-off conspiracy theory... in real life, that happens," Walder says.

episodes.title: The BBC interview that cost Prince Andrew everything | Unreported
episodes.description: Some stories make headlines. Others get ignored. On "Unreported," Meagan Medick takes a deeper look at the unexplained through the eyes and experiences of you, the viewers. You send the mystery — we investigate. In 2019, former Prince Andrew sat down with the BBC to clear his name, but what followed is considered to be one of the most catastrophic interviews in the history of the British monarchy. The interview created more questions than answers. Andrew faced a firestorm that ended his public-facing role in the royal family, lost his military titles and triggered a multimillion-dollar settlement with one of Jeffrey Epstein's accusers. This week, Medick speaks with Sam McAlister, the former BBC Newsnight producer who negotiated and booked the interview. McAlister takes Medick inside the room: how she convinced the prince to sit down, the private pre-interview conversation where he first revealed his "I don't sweat" defense and the moment on camera she knew the interview had gone catastrophically off the rails. They break down his responses to Virginia Giuffre's allegations, the infamous photo he claims may be fake, and whether any real accountability has followed. episodes.title: Bill Gates' Epstein review left out his personal emails — here's what we know | Unreported
episodes.description: Why weren't Bill Gates' personal emails included in a review of the Gates Foundation's ties to Jeffrey Epstein? In this bonus episode of "Unreported," Meagan Medick digs into new reporting about an outside investigation commissioned by the Gates Foundation into its historical interactions with Epstein. The review found no evidence that the foundation knowingly participated in Epstein's criminal activity — but investigators didn't review Bill Gates' personal emails or certain records outside the foundation. Meagan breaks down what the investigation examined, what it didn't, Gates' previously reported meetings with Epstein after Epstein's 2008 conviction and the flight records showing Gates aboard one of Epstein's planes in 2013. She also looks at Gates' recent appearance before the House Oversight Committee and the larger question now surrounding the foundation's review: If investigators didn't have access to Gates' personal communications, how complete was the investigation? Gates has denied any criminal wrongdoing or involvement in Epstein's crimes.
